title: So Cute!
text: So Cute!. This is such a cute tumbler! I ordered it for my daughter. It's very cheerful! It has texture so it is easy to grip. The cup is insulated and keeps your drink cold for a few hours - not as long as stainless cups, but longer than a non-insulated one. She really likes it!

product_metadata.title: West & Fifth Semitransparent Honeycomb-Textured Tumbler, Insulated Tumbler With Straw, 24 Ounces, Black
features: WATER TUMBLER: Keep yourself hydrated with our 24-ounce reusable tumbler for cold liquids like water, iced coffee, smoothies, and tea. Each cute tumbler holds 3 cups of cold beverages and has a matte rubber coat with a semitransparent, studded honeycomb design.

TRENDY TUMBLER: This unique studded tumbler has a rubberized texture for a nonslip grip, even when it’s wet, and keeps your liquids cold and refreshing for hours. The special rubber ring on the lid keeps it shut, and the straw base has a stopper that helps prevent your drink from leaking.

HIGH-QUALITY MATTE TUMBLER: Each large tumbler cup has a reusable straw and a threaded screw-on lid to prevent spills and is made with durable polystyrene and safe food-grade materials. All of our tumbler bottles are 100% free from BPA, BPS, phthalates, and mercury.

EASY-CARE TRAVEL TUMBLER: This lightweight, modern tumbler helps you stand out, and it’s easy to carry to the gym, to the office, around your home, or as you run errands. To wash, simply remove the lid and straw and handwash in the sink.

THE PERFECT GIFT: Gift this drink tumbler to anyone in your life who is on the go and wants to stand out from the crowd. Get this beverage tumbler for an iced-coffee or smoothie lover, or buy it for yourself as a brand-new drinking cup.
description: Need a way to keep your water or iced coffee cool throughout the day? West & Fifth introduces our handy reusable tumbler, the perfect cup for cold liquids that stands out from other tumblers. The outside is decorated with matte-coated rubber and features a unique semitransparent and spiky honeycomb texture that can massage your hands as you hold it. This textured tumbler holds 3 cups of your favorite beverage and maintains the temperature inside for hours to keep your drink refreshing. The lid has a special rubber ring that keeps it twisted on tight while preventing any spill or leak accidents, and each straw has a stopper ring on the base that keeps it from falling out and adds extra leak protection. Made with sturdy polystyrene and safe food-grade materials, this tumbler can withstand daily use as you go about your routine. It is lightweight enough to carry to the office, to your car, to the gym, or around your home, and it holds 24 oz. of liquid. Wrap up this tumbler to give to your loved ones as a fun way for them to stay hydrated while expressing their style. Find the cup you’ll love with our reusable tumbler options!All of our tumblers are 100% free from BPA, BPS, phthalates, and mercury for your safety and convenience. To wash your water and iced-coffee tumbler, remove the lid and the straw to clean the inside of the cup. Wash the cup by hand in a sink, and let it dry before the next use. This tumbler should not be used with hot liquids. Do not put this item in the dishwasher or in the microwave.At West & Fifth, we believe that there’s no such thing as a one-size-fits-all product. All of our products are exclusive, as they are designed in-house using fun, vibrant, fashion-forward, and custom colors and designs. Since inception, we’ve designed and launched over a thousand other quality products. We’re constantly bringing new products to market to fit with current seasons, colors, and trends that we’re sure you’ll love!
